append.detail: UPDATE 2026-11-10 (P5 slice 2, dark): the persistent cart store. Migration 20270346038000_commerce_carts.sql adds public.commerce_carts (one row per buyer, profile_id primary key, lines jsonb array capped at 50, own-row RLS) with a pgTAP guard in supabase/tests/commerce_carts.test.sql. lib/commerce/cart-store.ts loads (through parseCart), saves, adds, sets, removes and merges a guest cart; app/(main)/marketplace/cart-actions.ts exposes them behind COMMERCE_CART_ENABLED (blank = dark, gate in RUNBOOKS 'Persistent cart'); an Add to cart button sits beside Buy now on /market/<id> only when the switch is on. Still open: checkout from a saved cart, a /cart page, prune-on-read against live stock, P3 shipping profiles and P4 facets (Packet G UI). Daniel applies the SQL in Frequency Community after merge.
